rules.body: Apply when immediate document writes become reusable trailing work, document buffers have ownership independent of visible subscriptions, and callbacks can synchronously navigate. Confirm any departure deadline separately. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate."

Bind accepted edits to their originating document, replace pending text on each edit, and restart the quiet interval. Save only the latest text after that interval, while keeping the task reusable for subsequent bursts. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/workflow.go binds each buffer's work with "func(text string){env.Write(id,text)}".

Clear the completed batch's handle and pending text before invoking callback-capable work. Preserve newly queued work if the callback reenters, and preserve valid empty text through the pointer-based pending check. src/workflow.go: "text:=t.pending;t.handle=nil;t.pending=nil" followed by "if text!=nil { t.work(*text) }".

Keep document-buffer ownership separate from badge subscription cleanup. Detaching a badge must not discard independently owned document work; retain per-document buffer reuse and the no-current-view edit guard. Do not infer immediate departure flushing from independent ownership alone. docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription." src/workflow.go: "func(b *Badge)detach(){b.env.Store().Stop(b.token)}".

Preserve navigation authority across synchronous callbacks: capture the departing resource, clear current ownership, detach its subscription before publishing retirement, and retain the generation check before installing an opening. If a separately established policy adds callback-capable departure work, ensure its continuation cannot overwrite nested navigation. docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." src/workflow.go: "old:=w.current;w.current=nil" and "if true&&request!=w.generation{return}".

Preserve public interfaces, original document identities and text, status filtering and payload semantics. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics."

Keep the adjacent preview outside the repair, including its 40 ms interval, hide cancellation, and later reuse. Do not transfer persistent document policy to transient preview work. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/workflow.go: "NewTrailing(env,40,func(query string){env.Output(\"preview\",Value{\"query\":query})})" and "func(p *Preview)Hide(){p.task.Cancel()}".

Use controlled time to check no early write, latest text, deadline restart, later bursts, empty text, and independent document buffers. Exercise switch, close, dispose, same-document reopening, synchronous save/listener navigation, subscription cleanup, and preview cancellation/reuse. Check that buffer work survives badge retirement; assert a departure-time flush only when independently required by TASK or original public source. Treat observed passes and failures as examples rather than specification.

limitations: TASK and the original public source do not establish that departure must flush pending edits before returning. Buffer independence establishes ownership, not a departure deadline.
Attempts 1 and 2 supply implementation examples and reported observations; their outcomes do not establish business requirements, causality, or cross-task effectiveness.
Timer behavior after cancellation and synchronous invocation by Schedule are unspecified. Do not introduce requirements for those cases without additional public evidence.
The supplied subscription experiences concern bootstrap reception and delayed decoding. Those mechanisms are not present in this task and must not be imported as requirements.
No files were modified and no scorer, reference implementation, or hidden tests were accessed.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
